globin enhancer and promoter positive controls on gasperini
```{r load-results, echo=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
source("~/.Rprofile")

# 10 sceptre runs: 5 assignment methods x 2 cell-QC arms, 130 globin control
# pairs each (10 control targets x 13 genes, the positive_ctrl rows of GEO
# GSE120861_all_deg_results.at_scale). Each CSV carries `dataset`, `method`, `qc`.
out_dir <- file.path(.get_config_path("LOCAL_BENCHMARKING_DIR"),
                     "association", "assign-pos-control", "outputs", "gasperini_allcells_globin")
runs <- expand_grid(method = c("fishash", "fishashplus", "thresh3", "thresh5", "thresh10"),
                    qc     = c("none", "default"))

res <- map2(runs$method, runs$qc, \(m, q)
  read_csv(file.path(out_dir, paste0(m, "_", q), "association_on_target.csv"),
           show_col_types = FALSE)) |>
  bind_rows()

stopifnot(nrow(res) == 10 * 130,
          all(count(res, method, qc)$n == 130))
```

Experiment: compute p-values for the 130 globin control pairs in Gasperini for different assignments: the 10 control guide groups (enhancers HS1 to HS4 and globin promoters) tested against each of the 13 genes they were tested against in the original paper.

Assignment methods:

1. fishash

2. fishash+

3. thresholding with a threshold of 3, 5, and 10

This was done with and without cellwise QC (using SCEPTRE default if QC was done). No pairwise QC was done.

```{r pair-tags}
# Gene groups. ENSG -> gene names from GSE120861_all_deg_results.at_scale.txt.
gene_tags <- tribble(
  ~response_id,      ~gene,      ~gene_group,
  "ENSG00000213931", "HBE1",     "globin",
  "ENSG00000213934", "HBG1",     "globin",
  "ENSG00000196565", "HBG2",     "globin",
  "ENSG00000244734", "HBB",      "borderline",
  "ENSG00000223609", "HBD",      "borderline",
  "ENSG00000132256", "TRIM5",    "unlikely",
  "ENSG00000121236", "TRIM6",    "unlikely",
  "ENSG00000132109", "TRIM21",   "unlikely",
  "ENSG00000167333", "TRIM68",   "unlikely",
  "ENSG00000183251", "OR51B4",   "unlikely",
  "ENSG00000242180", "OR51B5",   "unlikely",
  "ENSG00000167359", "OR51I1",   "unlikely",
  "ENSG00000051009", "FAM160A2", "unlikely"
) |>
  mutate(gene_group = factor(gene_group, levels = c("globin", "borderline", "unlikely")))

# Guide groups (control targets): HS1 to HS4 enhancers vs globin promoters.
target_tags <- tribble(
  ~grna_target,                               ~element,   ~target_group,
  "pos_control_Klannchr_HS1",                 "HS1",      "enhancer",
  "pos_control_HS2_Klann_mosaic",             "HS2",      "enhancer",
  "pos_control_KlannHS2g_HS2_A",              "HS2",      "enhancer",
  "pos_control_KlannHS2g_HS2_B",              "HS2",      "enhancer",
  "pos_control_Klannchr1_HS3",                "HS3",      "enhancer",
  "pos_control_Klannchr1_HS4",                "HS4",      "enhancer",
  "pos_control_HBE1_tss_Klann_mosaic",        "HBE1 TSS", "promoter",
  "pos_control_mosaic_HB_HBE1_tss_A",         "HBE1 TSS", "promoter",
  "pos_control_mosaic_HB_HBE1_tss_B",         "HBE1 TSS", "promoter",
  "pos_control_Klannchr1_HBG1_HBG1_tss_both", "HBG1 TSS", "promoter"
) |>
  mutate(target_group = factor(target_group, levels = c("enhancer", "promoter")))

pair_tags <- cross_join(target_tags, gene_tags)

stopifnot(nrow(pair_tags) == 130,
          setequal(paste(pair_tags$grna_target, pair_tags$response_id),
                   paste(res$grna_target, res$response_id)))

res <- res |> left_join(pair_tags, by = c("grna_target", "response_id"))

# Very likely positive controls, chosen from biology (not from these results):
# the LCR enhancers HS1 to HS4 acting on the globins expressed in K562. Promoter
# guide groups are excluded so on-target knockdowns are not highlighted.
res <- res |>
  mutate(pair_group = if_else(target_group == "enhancer" & gene_group == "globin",
                              "Enhancer x HBE1/HBG1/HBG2", "Other"),
         pair_group = factor(pair_group, levels = c("Enhancer x HBE1/HBG1/HBG2", "Other")))
stopifnot(sum(res$pair_group == "Enhancer x HBE1/HBG1/HBG2") == 10 * 18)
```

```{r logp-plot-helper}
# -log10 p, fishash+ (x) against fishash and threshold 5 (y), one panel per
# comparator x QC arm. Points below the diagonal: fishash+ has the smaller p.
P_FLOOR <- 1e-250   # sceptre's smallest reported p-value

plot_logp <- function(d) {
  p_wide <- d |>
    select(grna_target, response_id, pair_group, qc, method, p_value) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = method, values_from = p_value)

  plot_df <- p_wide |>
    pivot_longer(c(fishash, thresh5), names_to = "comparator", values_to = "p_comparator") |>
    mutate(qc = factor(qc, levels = c("none", "default"),
                       labels = c("No cell QC", "Default cell QC")),
           comparator = factor(comparator, levels = c("fishash", "thresh5"),
                               labels = c("vs fishash", "vs threshold = 5")),
           x = -log10(fishashplus), y = -log10(p_comparator))

  # counts for the highlighted pairs only
  counts <- plot_df |>
    filter(pair_group == levels(pair_group)[1]) |>
    group_by(qc, comparator) |>
    summarise(fp_smaller  = sum(fishashplus < p_comparator),
              cmp_smaller = sum(fishashplus > p_comparator),
              ties        = sum(fishashplus == p_comparator),
              .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(label = paste0("highlighted pairs:\nfishash+ smaller p (below): ", fp_smaller,
                          "\ncomparator smaller p (above): ", cmp_smaller,
                          "\nties (incl. both at 1e-250): ", ties))

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = x, y = y, colour = pair_group, shape = pair_group)) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 1.8) +
    geom_text(data = counts, aes(label = label), x = -Inf, y = Inf,
              hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.2, size = 2.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("#D55E00", "grey40"), name = NULL) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 17), name = NULL) +
    facet_grid(comparator ~ qc) +
    coord_equal() +
    labs(x = "fishash+ -log10 p", y = "Comparator -log10 p") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}
```

All 130 pairs (promoter guide groups included, shown as "Other"):

```{r logp-all-pairs, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 9.5,fig.cap="All 130 pairs flagged as positive controls. The 18 pairs for enhancer-targeting guide group x (globin gene expressed by K562 cells) are highlighted."}
plot_logp(res)
```

Promoter guide groups removed (78 enhancer pairs, 6 guide groups x 13 genes: 18 highlighted, 60 other):

```{r logp-enhancer-pairs, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 9.5, fig.cap="Only the 78 enhancer-targeting pairs. The same 18 are highlighted. "}
res_enh <- res |> filter(target_group == "enhancer")
stopifnot(all(count(res_enh, method, qc)$n == 6 * 13))
plot_logp(res_enh)
```

This suggests that fishash+ adds power. 


The same comparison on `z_orig`, the observed test statistic before sceptre compares it with its fitted skew-normal null. Unlike the p-value, it has no 1e-250 floor. Knockdown gives negative z, so for th
ose pairs a point above the diagonal means fishash+ has the stronger (more negative) z.

```{r z-plot-helper}
plot_z <- function(d) {
  z_wide <- d |>
    select(grna_target, response_id, pair_group, qc, method, z_orig) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = method, values_from = z_orig)

  plot_df <- z_wide |>
    pivot_longer(c(fishash, thresh5), names_to = "comparator", values_to = "z_comparator") |>
    mutate(qc = factor(qc, levels = c("none", "default"),
                       labels = c("No cell QC", "Default cell QC")),
           comparator = factor(comparator, levels = c("fishash", "thresh5"),
                               labels = c("vs fishash", "vs threshold = 5")))

  # counts for the highlighted pairs only, by |z| so the sign of the effect does not matter
  counts <- plot_df |>
    filter(pair_group == levels(pair_group)[1]) |>
    group_by(qc, comparator) |>
    summarise(fp_larger  = sum(abs(fishashplus) > abs(z_comparator)),
              cmp_larger = sum(abs(fishashplus) < abs(z_comparator)),
              ties       = sum(abs(fishashplus) == abs(z_comparator)),
              .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(label = paste0("highlighted pairs:\nfishash+ larger |z|: ", fp_larger,
                          "\ncomparator larger |z|: ", cmp_larger,
                          "\nties: ", ties))

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = fishashplus, y = z_comparator, colour = pair_group, shape = pair_group)) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey85") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey85") +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 1.8) +
    geom_text(data = counts, aes(label = label), x = Inf, y = -Inf,
              hjust = 1.05, vjust = -0.3, size = 2.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("#D55E00", "grey40"), name = NULL) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 17), name = NULL) +
    facet_grid(comparator ~ qc) +
    coord_equal() +
    labs(x = "fishash+ z", y = "Comparator z") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}
```


All 130 pairs (promoter guide groups included, shown as "Other"):

```{r z-all-pairs, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 9.5}
plot_z(res)
```

Promoter guide groups removed (78 enhancer pairs: 18 highlighted, 60 other):

```{r z-enhancer-pairs, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 9.5}
plot_z(res_enh)
```

What are the extra cells fishash+ assigns? For each enhancer guide group: the cells assigned to the group (any of its guides) by fishash+ but by none of its guides under fishash, and the group's gRNA UMI count in each of those cells (summed over its guides; one guide for HS1, HS3, HS4). Assignments do not depend on QC; the QC column drops the cells removed by cell QC.

```{r extra-cells-umi, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 12}
# thesis histogram style: exact bins 0..10 then doubling widths, log10(count + 1),
# one bin structure shared by every panel
source("../../../benchmarking/guide-assignment/assignment-analysis/assignment-helpers.R")

in_root <- file.path(.get_config_path("LOCAL_BENCHMARKING_DIR"),
                     "association", "assign-pos-control", "input_data", "gasperini_allcells_globin")
fa <- readRDS(file.path(in_root, "grna", "fishash.rds"))        # binary, guides x cells
fp <- readRDS(file.path(in_root, "grna", "fishashplus.rds"))
guide_df <- read.csv(file.path(in_root, "shared", "grna_target_data_frame.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
qc_excl  <- readRDS(file.path(in_root, "shared", "qc_excluded_cells.rds"))$excluded_idx
stopifnot(identical(dimnames(fa), dimnames(fp)), identical(rownames(fp), guide_df$grna_id))

# raw counts for the 14 guides, from the full gRNA ODM (columns in the same order)
grna_odm <- ondisc::initialize_odm_from_backing_file(
  file.path(.get_config_path("LOCAL_BENCHMARKING_DIR"),
            "guide_assignment", "input_data", "gasperini", "sceptre-pipeline", "grna.odm"))
odm_rows <- match(rownames(fp), rownames(grna_odm))
stopifnot(!anyNA(odm_rows))
grna_counts <- t(vapply(odm_rows, function(r) as.numeric(grna_odm[r, ]), numeric(ncol(fp))))
dimnames(grna_counts) <- dimnames(fp)
# every fishash+ assignment sits on a count >= 2 (run_fishashplus.R min_count = 2)
stopifnot(all(grna_counts[as.matrix(fp) == 1] >= 2))

enh_targets <- target_tags |> filter(target_group == "enhancer")
extra <- map_dfr(enh_targets$grna_target, function(g) {
  rows  <- which(guide_df$grna_target == g)
  in_fp <- Matrix::colSums(fp[rows, , drop = FALSE]) > 0
  in_fa <- Matrix::colSums(fa[rows, , drop = FALSE]) > 0
  cells <- which(in_fp & !in_fa)
  tibble(grna_target = g, cell = cells,
         umi = colSums(grna_counts[rows, cells, drop = FALSE]))
})

extra_qc <- bind_rows(
  extra |> mutate(qc = "No cell QC"),
  extra |> filter(!cell %in% qc_excl) |> mutate(qc = "Default cell QC")
) |>
  mutate(qc = factor(qc, levels = c("No cell QC", "Default cell QC")),
         grna_target = factor(grna_target, levels = enh_targets$grna_target))

# panel labels: element, number of guides, number of extra cells
panel_labels <- extra_qc |>
  count(grna_target, qc, .drop = FALSE) |>
  mutate(element = enh_targets$element[match(grna_target, enh_targets$grna_target)],
         guides  = map_int(as.character(grna_target), \(g) sum(guide_df$grna_target == g)),
         label   = paste0(element, " (", guides, if_else(guides > 1, " guides", " guide"),
                          "): ", n, " extra cells"))

b <- bin_umi_counts(extra_qc, c("grna_target", "qc"))
ggplot(b$counts) +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = 0, ymax = logp1(count)),
            fill = "#D55E00", colour = NA) +
  geom_text(data = panel_labels, aes(label = label), x = Inf, y = Inf,
            hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.4, size = 2.8) +
  facet_grid(grna_target ~ qc) +
  umi_hist_scales(b) +
  labs(x = "gRNA UMI count (guide group total)", y = "Number of cells") +
  theme_thesis() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
        strip.text.y = element_blank())
```

Unassigning fishash+'s extra calls: for each guide, the (guide, cell) entries fishash+ assigns and fishash does not are set to unassigned if their UMI count is below a threshold, so those cells become controls for that guide group. Unassigning all of them gives exactly fishash's assignment. "Before" is fishash+ as is.

```{r load-unassign}
unassign_runs <- expand_grid(qc = c("none", "default"), t = c("3", "4", "inf"))
res_un <- map2(unassign_runs$qc, unassign_runs$t, \(q, t)
  read_csv(file.path(out_dir, paste0("fishashplus_", q, "_unassign", t), "association_on_target.csv"),
           col_types = cols(unassign = col_character()), show_col_types = FALSE)) |>
  bind_rows()
stopifnot(nrow(res_un) == 6 * 130, all(count(res_un, qc, unassign)$n == 130))

before <- res |>
  filter(method == "fishashplus") |>
  select(grna_target, response_id, qc, pair_group, p_before = p_value, z_before = z_orig)

unassign_df <- res_un |>
  select(grna_target, response_id, qc, unassign, p_after = p_value, z_after = z_orig) |>
  left_join(before, by = c("grna_target", "response_id", "qc")) |>
  mutate(qc = factor(qc, levels = c("none", "default"), labels = c("No cell QC", "Default cell QC")),
         unassign = factor(unassign, levels = c("3", "4", "inf"),
                           labels = c("unassign count < 3", "unassign count < 4", "unassign all (= fishash)")))
stopifnot(!anyNA(unassign_df$p_before))
```

Points below the diagonal: fishash+ before unassigning has the smaller p.

```{r unassign-logp, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 13}
counts_p <- unassign_df |>
  filter(pair_group == levels(pair_group)[1]) |>
  group_by(unassign, qc) |>
  summarise(before_smaller = sum(p_before < p_after),
            after_smaller  = sum(p_before > p_after),
            ties           = sum(p_before == p_after), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(label = paste0("highlighted pairs:\nbefore smaller p (below): ", before_smaller,
                        "\nafter smaller p (above): ", after_smaller,
                        "\nties (incl. both at 1e-250): ", ties))

ggplot(unassign_df, aes(x = -log10(p_before), y = -log10(p_after),
                        colour = pair_group, shape = pair_group)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 1.8) +
  geom_text(data = counts_p, aes(label = label), x = -Inf, y = Inf,
            hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.2, size = 2.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#D55E00", "grey40"), name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 17), name = NULL) +
  facet_grid(unassign ~ qc) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = "fishash+ -log10 p (before)", y = "-log10 p after unassigning") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

Knockdown gives negative z, so for those pairs a point above the diagonal means fishash+ before unassigning has the stronger (more negative) z.

```{r unassign-z, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 13}
Z_MAX <- 40    # keep pairs with |z| <= Z_MAX both before and after; Inf keeps all

z_df <- unassign_df |> filter(abs(z_before) <= Z_MAX, abs(z_after) <= Z_MAX)

counts_z <- unassign_df |>
  filter(pair_group == levels(pair_group)[1]) |>
  group_by(unassign, qc) |>
  summarise(n_dropped     = sum(abs(z_before) > Z_MAX | abs(z_after) > Z_MAX),
            before_larger = sum(abs(z_before) > abs(z_after) & abs(z_before) <= Z_MAX & abs(z_after) <= Z_MAX),
            after_larger  = sum(abs(z_before) < abs(z_after) & abs(z_before) <= Z_MAX & abs(z_after) <= Z_MAX),
            ties          = sum(abs(z_before) == abs(z_after) & abs(z_before) <= Z_MAX), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(label = paste0("highlighted pairs:\nbefore larger |z|: ", before_larger,
                        "\nafter larger |z|: ", after_larger, "\nties: ", ties,
                        if (is.finite(Z_MAX)) paste0("\ndropped (|z| > ", Z_MAX, "): ", n_dropped) else ""))

ggplot(z_df, aes(x = z_before, y = z_after, colour = pair_group, shape = pair_group)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey85") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey85") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 1.8) +
  geom_text(data = counts_z, aes(label = label), x = Inf, y = -Inf,
            hjust = 1.05, vjust = -0.3, size = 2.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#D55E00", "grey40"), name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 17), name = NULL) +
  facet_grid(unassign ~ qc) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = "fishash+ z (before)", y = "z after unassigning") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
